title: GTA 6 Fronts Next Game Informer Cover with New Info and Screenshots
description: GTA 6 is set to feature on the next Game Informer cover on September 29, 2026, featuring a 14-page story, exclusive Rockstar interviews, and a dozen new screenshots.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Takes the Spotlight on Game Informer's Next Cover

The anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world epic continues to mount as new promotional milestones approach. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, Grand Theft Auto VI is officially set to grace the front cover of the next issue of Game Informer, bringing with it a wave of fresh information and visuals.

## Jason and Lucia Featured in Stylized Cover Art

The new cover art prominently showcases the game's two central protagonists, Jason and Lucia, captured in yet another stylized image. The duo is depicted inside a car equipped with weapons, immediately signaling the high-octane criminal adventures and Bonnie-and-Clyde dynamic that players can expect when the title launches.

## Exclusive Interviews and Over a Dozen New Screenshots

Mark your calendars, as the eagerly awaited issue is scheduled to drop on **29th September 2026**. Game Informer has teased that the upcoming release will feature a massive **14-page cover story**, complete with exclusive interviews with the developers at Rockstar Games. Furthermore, fans can look forward to **a dozen new screenshots** offering a closer look at the game's open-world environment and visual fidelity.

While we must wait until next week's official publication to dive into the specifics of the interviews and examine the new screenshots in detail, this upcoming feature promises to be one of the most substantial informational drops we've seen so far. 

## Editor's Take

This upcoming Game Informer feature marks a significant and welcome step in the communication surrounding GTA 6. A 14-page deep dive paired with exclusive Rockstar interviews and fresh screenshots is exactly what the community has been craving. As we count down to September 29th, expectations are high that these new details will give us a clearer picture of how Rockstar is shaping its next masterpiece.
